page.layout: Running head at top with page number 149 at upper left. One column of main text, with paragraphs XII to XV, then running prose below. Two marginal notes in the left margin: one beside the paragraph "Quemadmodum", one beside the paragraph "epistolæ sententiis".

rare magna volueris, de omnibus ad me primo quo-
que tempore scribes, & quod facis, me meaq; studia
est, munus, ut de fortuna prospera succes-

ficium agnoscant, idque missis ad ami-
cos literis testatum faciant. Neque vero

plificantibus, petitis: à causis, effectis, ad-

marginalia.note: De ratione respondendi ad aliorum gratulationes.

page.notes: Greek words in the first paragraph and in the paragraph "epistolæ sententiis" are uncertain at several points; the line-end word "grati" runs on to the next page. "sparge-batur" has a tilde over the a in "bātur" that is hard to read. The left note "respondë-do observan-dæ" is set in small type and was read as "respondendo observandæ". The Greek in the XIII line is partly illegible.
